title: Ruthless Bar Salts Wild Berrylicious 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Wild Berrylicious offers a mesmerising medley of forest fruits, combining sweet strawberries, tart raspberries, juicy blueberries, and bold blackberries. Each inhale delivers a deftly layered fusion of authentic berry flavours, striking a perfect balance between jammy sweetness and berry tang. The result is a full-bodied, fruity vape that stays indulgently smooth from start to finish. Blended with 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid strikes a balance between vapour production and flavour intensity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and classic vape starter devices. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. Ruthless is one of the pioneers of American e-liquids, known for crafting bold and unique flavours that have influenced the industry for years. Their expertly blended shortfills continue to be a favourite among vapers looking for high-quality, distinct and flavourful e-liquids that push the boundaries of what’s possible in e-liquid.
